meta.name: notebooklm
meta.description: Use this skill to query your Google NotebookLM notebooks directly from Claude Code for source-grounded, citation-backed answers from Gemini. Browser automation, library management, persistent auth. Drastically reduced hallucinations through document-only responses.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 向你的笔记库提问,获得带引用的答案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常在大量笔记中找答案
copy.tagline_en: Ask your notes for answers with citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often dig through piles of notes for answers

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能直接查询你的 Google NotebookLM 笔记本,检查登录状态、管理笔记本库、用自然语言提问。答案只来自你上传的文档,由 Gemini 生成并带引用;每次提问新开浏览器会话,结束即关,并会追问是否还有需要。
howto.when: 当你提到 NotebookLM、分享其链接,或说出“ask my NotebookLM”“check my docs”等查询意图时触发。

say.text: 用我的 NotebookLM 笔记本回答:上季度销售数据是多少?
say.note: Claude 会查询并返回带来源的答案。

say.text: 列出我的 NotebookLM 笔记本
say.note: 显示已保存的笔记本列表。

say.text: 把这个 NotebookLM 链接加进我的库
say.note: Claude 会先查询内容,再补全名称、描述和主题。

howto.what_en: Claude can query your Google NotebookLM notebooks: check auth, manage notebook library, ask natural-language questions. Answers come only from your uploaded docs, with Gemini citations. Each question opens and closes a fresh browser session.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention NotebookLM, share a NotebookLM URL, ask to query notebooks/docs, or want to add documentation to the NotebookLM library.

say_en.text: Use my NotebookLM notebook: what were last quarter's sales figures?
say_en.note: Claude queries and returns a cited answer.

say_en.text: Add this NotebookLM notebook to my library, auto-detecting topics.
say_en.note: Claude queries content first, then fills metadata.
